text:
tasha: FYI canary is spiking error-rate on inference-runtime v2.5.0 in eu-west1, p95 up ~120ms and 5% 5xx. Deploy-bot alerted at 08:02 UTC. Holding next wave.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary metrics exceeded threshold for service=inference-runtime region=eu-west1 metric=p95 latency, trigger=canary.safeguard. auto-hold applied. See /deploy/1755 for details. :warning: 

maya: thanks — I was looking at logs, looks like kvcache eviction change from yesterday might be amplifying tail requests. low-confidence regression but consistent across a few pods.

sam: agree with holding the wave. options: 1) automated rollback of whole wave, 2) targeted downgrade for eu-west1, 3) cherry-pick kvcache fix into a patched release. pref for 2+3 so we avoid global churn.

leo: I can cherry-pick the kvcache fix to v2.4.7 and run a quick canary against eu-west1. If it passes, we can resume. ETA ~25m.

ops-oncall: i'll prepare a short customer note for Dedicated customers in eu-west1 and flag the SD portal. Also enabling extended logging on the canary group.

maya: +1 for targeted downgrade then patch. let's limit traffic shift to 10% eu-west1 and keep fallback to v2.4.7. Need manual approval for downgrade since this conflicts with the scheduled wave.

tasha: Approved. leo, perform cherry-pick + build. sam, coordinate traffic-split. ops-oncall, send the comms.

leo: cherry-pick done, started build and pushing image tag inference-runtime:2.4.7-kvpatch. Docker push complete.

leo: initiating targeted traffic shift:
```
# traffic tool command
trafficctl shift --service inference-runtime --region eu-west1 --from v2.5.0 --to inference-runtime:2.4.7-kvpatch --percent 10 --strategy gradual --reason "canary p95 spike"
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Traffic shift started. id=ts-1755-42. Monitor canary group metrics for 20m window. Auto-fallback enabled if error-rate > 4% or p95 > +100ms.

sam: monitoring dashboards now. if we hit fallback, we'll execute manual rollback runbook.

ops-oncall: customer note posted to status page draft, will publish if impact persists.

maya: initial 10% looks stable at +5m, p95 reduced ~30ms on patched pods. No increase in 5xx so far.

leo: increasing to 30% to get better signal.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Traffic shift updated to 30%.

sam: metrics look good at 30% after 10m. recommend stay for full 20m window then resume wave if green.

tasha: agree. hold the rest of the wave until we finish the window. if all clear, proceed with scheduled wave resume and include the patched image in release notes.

ops-oncall: publishing brief to customers: "We observed a canary latency increase in eu-west1; we've applied a targeted patch and shifted 30% of traffic to the patched runtime while we validate. No customer-facing impact detected. We will update within 1 hour." :loudspeaker: 

sam: after 20m window completes green, planned resume command:
```
deployctl resume --wave 1755 --include-image inference-runtime:2.4.7-kvpatch --note "canary patch for kvcache eviction"
```

maya: add eval test for long-tail queries to our post-deploy checks to catch this earlier next time.

tasha: good action items. Thanks everyone for quick coord. Closing this thread once wave resumes or if we need to flip to manual rollback. :white_check_mark:
